### Your observed May spend

In May, your purchases at both retailers were charged to your **Chase Freedom Unlimited**:
- **Costco Wholesale**: $736.80 across two trips ($424.18 on May 4 and $312.62 on May 18)
- **Target**: $242.19 on May 21

Because major credit card issuers code wholesale clubs and discount superstores outside the traditional supermarket category (MCC 5411), neither qualifies for the 4x grocery multiplier on your **American Express Gold Card** (which Amex also does not accept in-warehouse at Costco, where only Visa is accepted). On your Freedom Unlimited, these earn the baseline **1.5% cash back** (~$11.05 from Costco and ~$3.63 from Target).

---

### Key card and membership moves

1. **Target Circle Card (Debit or Credit)** — **Instant 5% checkout discount**
   - Saves **5% directly at the register** on eligible Target purchases, avoiding rewards redemption friction entirely.
   - On your observed $242.19 purchase, that is an immediate $12.11 savings (versus ~$3.63 back on the Freedom Unlimited).
   - If May is typical ($242.19 × 12 = ~$2,906/yr), a 5% discount yields roughly **$145/year in savings**.
   - *Low-admin tip:* The debit version links directly to your existing checking account without requiring a hard credit pull or another card balance to track.

2. **Costco Executive Membership Upgrade** — **2% annual reward certificate**
   - Upgrading from Gold Star ($65/yr) to Executive ($130/yr) costs an extra **$65/year** and earns 2% back on qualified warehouse and Costco.com purchases (up to $1,250/yr).
   - At your observed May pace of $736.80/month ($8,841.60/yr annualized), the 2% Executive reward yields **~$176.83/year**, comfortably clearing the $65 upgrade fee by over **$111/year**.
   - *Breakeven check:* You only need to spend **$3,250/year** ($271/month) at Costco for the 2% reward to fully offset the $65 upgrade cost.

3. **Costco Anywhere Visa by Citi** — **2% at Costco, 5% on Costco gas**
   - Earns **2% on Costco purchases**, 5% on Costco gas / 4% on other eligible gas & EV charging (first $7,000/yr combined, then 1%), and 3% on dining/travel, with no annual fee beyond your Costco membership.
   - The 2% card reward stacks on top of the 2% Executive reward for a combined **4% back** on qualified Costco spending.
   - *Watch out:* Rewards pay out once a year as a merchandise certificate redeemable only at Costco, and adding another card adds account maintenance. If you prefer keeping finances simple, starting with just the Executive upgrade or a flat 2% Visa keeps the admin low.
